headline: Silicon Valley AI developer Anthropic weighs public listing
summary: Artificial intelligence startup Anthropic is evaluating an initial public offering in the United States following high revenue growth, attracting institutional investor focus.
why: Anthropic is a top-tier generative AI model developer backed by major tech firms including Amazon and Alphabet.

impacts.name: Anthropic
impacts.why: Potential public listing preparations highlight strong capital demands across generative AI developers.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
